The world is full of places we haven't truly seen.Kashmir, 34° north

I love the outdoors, especially places with a story waiting to be found.

From cycling routes and mountain views to local history and nature's mysteries, Explore with Muntazir shares the Kashmir that deserves a closer look.

I'm also learning video editing and social media management as I work toward financial independence. I'm still practising and growing with every project. Come along for the journey.

🚲 Cycling🏔 Mountains🎬 Filmmaking📜 Local history🌿 Nature

Kashmir has stories still waiting to be told.

My signature project, built to explore the overlooked, the mysterious and the beautiful. Made together with my co-creator Fayiz.
